title: indexOf / find
description: Locate values or matching elements with indexOf, includes, find, findIndex, some, and every.

notes: indexOf / lastIndexOf use === so they cannot find NaN; includes can.
find returns the VALUE; findIndex returns the INDEX.
some and every short-circuit — they stop as soon as the answer is decided.

options: find returns the first match, findIndex returns an array of all match indices
find returns the value, findIndex returns the index
find mutates the array, while findIndex is non-mutating
findIndex returns -1 on miss while find returns null on miss

questions.q: some vs every — which says ANY element matches?

exercises.prompt: Find the index of 30 and check if 99 is present.
Get the first user whose id is 2.

blanks.hint: returns the matching VALUE, not the index
returns the matching INDEX, not value

L3.prompt: Write `firstEven(arr)` returning the first even number using find. Log `firstEven([1, 3, 5, 8, 9])`.
hints: find takes a predicate and returns the first value that satisfies it.
